landing.tagline: A friendly corner of the fediverse, open to Mastodon, diaspora* and beyond.

login.title: Sign in
login.subtitle: Welcome back to Disbigle.
login.mfaTotpHelp: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
login.mfaRecoveryHelp: Enter one of the recovery codes you saved when you enabled two-step verification.
login.codeInvalid: Enter the code shown by your app (at least 6 characters).
login.mfaExpired: Your sign-in expired. Please enter your password again.

register.title: Create your account
register.subtitle: Join {{domain}} and connect with the whole fediverse.
register.approvalNotice: New accounts on this server are reviewed by a moderator before they can be used.
register.usernameHint: Letters, digits and underscores. Your address will be @username@{{domain}}.
register.reason: Why do you want to join?
register.reasonHint: This helps the moderators review your request.
register.agreement: I accept the rules and the privacy policy of {{domain}}
register.pendingBody: Your request has been received. You will be able to sign in as soon as a moderator approves your account.
register.closedBody: {{domain}} is not accepting new accounts at the moment.

profile.notFound: There is no account called @{{username}} here.

profile.title: Profile
profile.description: How other people see you, here and across the fediverse.
profile.bioHint: Plain text. Line breaks are kept.
profile.fieldsHint: Up to {{max}} items shown on your profile, such as a website or your pronouns.
profile.lockedHint: You choose who can follow you.
profile.discoverable: Show my profile in directories and suggestions
profile.discoverableHint: Other people can find you more easily.
profile.botHint: Marks the account as a bot that may not be monitored.

account.title: Account
account.passwordHint: You will stay signed in here; all your other sessions will be signed out.

security.title: Security
security.description: Two-step verification and passkeys keep your account safe.

totp.title: Two-step verification
totp.description: Ask for a code from an authenticator app after your password.
totp.step1: Scan the QR code with an authenticator app, or enter the key by hand.
totp.step2: Type the 6-digit code the app shows to finish.
totp.qrAlt: QR code to add Disbigle to your authenticator app
totp.disableDescription: Your account will be protected by your password only.

recovery.title: Recovery codes
recovery.description: Create a new set of codes. The old ones will stop working.
recovery.saveDescription: Each code works once, if you lose access to your authenticator app. They will not be shown again.

passkeys.title: Passkeys
passkeys.description: Sign in with your fingerprint, face, screen lock or a security key instead of a password.
passkeys.name: Passkey name

fields.username: Use 1 to 30 letters, digits or underscores.
fields.agreement: You must accept the rules to continue.

errors.bad_request: The request could not be processed.
errors.forbidden: You are not allowed to do that.
errors.conflict: That conflicts with the current state. Reload and try again.
errors.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes and try again.
errors.mfa_required: A second verification step is required.
errors.email_taken: This email address is already registered.
errors.registrations_closed: Registrations are closed on this server.
errors.invalid_invite: The invitation code is invalid or has expired.
errors.account_pending_approval: Your account is waiting for a moderator's approval.
errors.internal_error: Something went wrong on our side. Please try again.
errors.network_error: Cannot reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
errors.unknown_error: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.webauthn_cancelled: The passkey request was cancelled or timed out.
errors.webauthn_already_registered: This device already has a passkey for your account.
errors.webauthn_unsupported: This browser does not support passkeys.
errors.too_many_attempts: Too many attempts. Sign in again.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.description: The page you are looking for does not exist or has moved.
